Horizons Arabic Level 1 - Interactive Arabic Letters Workbook — 1.2.0 — Free demo
إعداد وتنفيذ: إسماعيل الخطيب — ismail alhatip

Content: 5 letter lessons, 100 words, 100 example sentences and 10 illustrated stories.
Audio: 245 distinct bundled recording files, counted from this edition's audio index. Included Arabic recordings use a synthetic female voice; optional local device speech is only a fallback.
Illustrations: 240 indexed scenes using 240 distinct image files. Source illustrations supplied for HORIZONS were mapped to curriculum content; supplementary illustrations fill gaps and correct identified subject mismatches.
Writing: 20 contextual writing models, with tracing paths and numbered writing guidance. Practice does not automatically assess handwriting or mastery.
The interface, operating instructions and covers are available in 32 languages. Arabic lesson text and recordings remain in Arabic. Optional meaning translations are available in English, Turkish, French and Spanish.

Fonts: Noto Naskh Arabic, Amiri, Scheherazade, Noto Sans Arabic and Noto Kufi Arabic, under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Original font notices are retained in fonts/. Interface and guide font notices are in guides/assets/fonts/LICENSES.txt.
Library attribution retained from the workbook: fflate 0.8.2 (MIT) and js-sha256 0.11.1 (MIT). Their licence notices are retained in vendor/FFLATE-LICENSE.txt and vendor/SHA256-LICENSE.txt.

This demo has no licence activation and no update service. It does not ask for an email, child data or an account. Learning progress remains in the browser.


Instructions and privacy information: START_HERE.html and guides/<language-code>.html.
